title: Pigly's UHC Heads
description: A lightweight player head drops plugin with golden heads and a life system.
body:
# Pigly's UHC Heads

This plugin is just for lives and golden heads and is not extendable. For a more customizable and extendable heads plugin, check out my main heads plugin, [Pigly's Player Head Drops](https://modrinth.com/plugin/piglys-player-head-drops).

The server owner can set the number of lives each player gets. Each time a player dies, they'll drop their head, which other players can craft golden heads with.

The cooldown for golden heads can be set in the config.
